01 · ABOUT THE PROJECT

Understanding the community's water needs

The project studies drinking water availability and facilities, encourages safe water practices and identifies areas where community awareness and infrastructure improvements may help.

🎯

Objectives

Understand clean-water infrastructure, identify water-supply components, examine the impact of inadequate facilities and suggest sustainable improvements.

🤝

Community engagement

Interact with residents and school communities, collect feedback and share awareness about safe drinking water and conservation.

🌱

Learning outcomes

Develop teamwork, communication, problem-solving, leadership and environmental responsibility through field activities.

Area note: Weekly activity descriptions refer to AC Nagar, Nellore. The report's community overview also names North Mopur and Pusalapalem. Confirm the exact study-area scope with your guide.
02 · WATER FACILITIES

Water sources and access

The report discusses different water sources and asks residents about access, reliability, quality and household practices.

🚰

Tap water

Household or community tap connections; consider supply timing, continuity, cleanliness and maintenance.

🪨

Groundwater

Water from underground sources. Drinking suitability should be established through appropriate testing.

🌧️

Rainwater

Rainwater harvesting can support conservation when collection, storage and treatment are properly planned.

🫗

Purified water

The survey asks whether residents use purified or packaged drinking water and how confident they are about its quality.

🏫

School facilities

The project includes observing drinking-water facilities in local schools and gathering student feedback.

🧪

Water quality

The weekly plan introduces water-quality parameters, sample collection and basic testing methods.

03 · COMMUNITY SURVEY

What did the survey ask?

The report includes a household questionnaire focused on access, quality, cost and awareness.

Access and availability

Do you have access to underground water?
Do you have access to tap water?
Do you have access to purified water?
Have you ever faced a shortage of water?
What is your main source of drinking water?
How much do you spend on drinking water?

Quality and awareness

Are you satisfied with drinking-water quality?
Do you have any problem with tap-water quality?
What is the main source of water pollution?
What are you doing to improve drinking-water quality?
Are you aware of government efforts to protect water?
What is society's role in preventing water pollution?

05 · PROBLEMS IDENTIFIED

Challenges affecting water resources

The report lists broad water-management challenges. These are issues for assessment, not confirmed test findings for every AC Nagar household.

🧫

Water contamination

Potential pollution from waste disposal, industrial discharge and agricultural runoff.

🏗️

Infrastructure gaps

Insufficient wastewater treatment and sewage-disposal facilities can affect water bodies.

🌊

Urban runoff

Runoff can carry litter and other pollutants from roads and built-up areas into waterways.

📢

Limited awareness

Residents may need information about safe storage, water quality and conservation.

🌦️

Climate pressures

Changing rainfall patterns can contribute to runoff, erosion and sediment movement.

⚖️

Unequal access

Economic differences and infrastructure gaps can affect access to reliable clean water.

06 · ACTION PLAN

Practical recommendations

Suggested short-term and long-term actions drawn from the report.

SHORT-TERM

Immediate actions

  • Assess and monitor water quality regularly.
  • Identify and respond to immediate pollution sources.
  • Conduct public-awareness programmes on clean water and waste disposal.
  • Work with local authorities to strengthen compliance with water-protection rules.
LONG-TERM

Sustainable improvements

  • Improve sewage treatment and drainage infrastructure.
  • Support research into water-treatment and pollution-prevention technologies.
  • Develop long-term water-resource management policies.
  • Coordinate with relevant agencies and community stakeholders.
07 · CSE MINI PROJECT

Automatic Water Pump Controller Using Relays

The report proposes an Arduino-based controller that monitors tank level using an ultrasonic sensor and controls a DC pump through a relay. Its aim is to reduce manual operation and help prevent overflow and dry running.

🔵 Arduino Uno
Controller
📡 HC-SR04
Ultrasonic sensor
🔌 Relay module

💧 DC water pump

08 · CONCLUSION

Building awareness for safer water

This project connects field interaction, awareness and a simple automation concept. It highlights the importance of understanding local water access, encouraging safe practices, collecting reliable evidence and recommending improvements with community participation.
